options.markdown:
# 🎯 Mission Control

Live pulse of the Grok Bot box and the household processes it watches. Gauges arrive hourly (around :07 Pacific) as `grokbot.*`. Open a dashboard below for the full story.

**Overview** · [Bot Health](https://app.<REALM>.signalfx.com/#/dashboard/<DASHBOARD_ID_BOT_HEALTH>) · [Golf](https://app.<REALM>.signalfx.com/#/dashboard/<DASHBOARD_ID_GOLF>) · [Trading](https://app.<REALM>.signalfx.com/#/dashboard/<DASHBOARD_ID_TRADING>) · [Birds](https://app.<REALM>.signalfx.com/#/dashboard/<DASHBOARD_ID_BIRDS>) · [Home](https://app.<REALM>.signalfx.com/#/dashboard/<DASHBOARD_ID_HOME>) · [Ops](https://app.<REALM>.signalfx.com/#/dashboard/<DASHBOARD_ID_OPS>)

[Open the Grok Bot group](https://app.<REALM>.signalfx.com/#/dashboard-group/<GROUP_ID>) · green healthy · gold watch · red act · sparklines follow the dashboard time window.

chart.name: Box resources vs 6h average
chart.programText:
cpu = data('grokbot.box.cpu.pct')
mem = data('grokbot.box.mem.pct')
disk = data('grokbot.box.disk.pct')

cpu.mean(over='6h').publish('CPU 6h avg')
mem.publish('Mem')
disk.publish('Disk')

chart.name: Account value now vs 1 hour ago
chart.programText:
cur = data('grokbot.trade.account_value')
cur.publish('Now')
cur.timeshift('1h').publish('1h ago')
(cur - cur.timeshift('1h')).publish('Delta')

options.markdown:
# 🛰️ APM traces

Each hourly emit (`:07` Pacific) sends one OpenTelemetry trace for service **grokbot-emitter**, with a child span per collector (box, golf, trading, birds, home, email, calendar, backup, jobs, ebay, routines).

[Open APM](https://app.<REALM>.signalfx.com/#/apm/home) and look up service `grokbot-emitter`. Metric names are still `grokbot.*` (OTLP/HTTP); custom MTS should stay about 95.
